turns.question: How many tracks are in the database?
turns.sql: SELECT count(*) AS tracks FROM track

turns.question: What is the total revenue for each billing country? Show the country and the revenue.
turns.sql: SELECT billing_country, sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country

turns.question: Only for 2024.
turns.sql: SELECT billing_country, sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY billing_country

turns.question: Now just the top 3 countries, highest first.
turns.sql: SELECT billing_country, sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

turns.question: List all genre names in alphabetical order.
turns.sql: SELECT name FROM genre ORDER BY name

turns.question: How many tracks are there in the Jazz genre?
turns.sql: SELECT count(*) AS tracks FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Jazz'

turns.question: What about Blues?
turns.sql: SELECT count(*) AS tracks FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Blues'

turns.question: And what is their average unit price?
turns.sql: SELECT avg(t.unit_price) AS avg_price FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Blues'

turns.question: Which customers live in Brazil? Give their first and last names.
turns.sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil'

turns.question: List the titles of the albums by Led Zeppelin.
turns.sql: SELECT a.title FROM album a JOIN artist r ON r.artist_id = a.artist_id WHERE r.name = 'Led Zeppelin'

turns.question: How many tracks does each of them have? Show the title and the count.
turns.sql: SELECT a.title, count(*) AS tracks FROM album a JOIN artist r ON r.artist_id = a.artist_id JOIN track t ON t.album_id = a.album_id WHERE r.name = 'Led Zeppelin' GROUP BY a.album_id, a.title

turns.question: Which of those albums is the longest in total running time?
turns.sql: SELECT a.title FROM album a JOIN artist r ON r.artist_id = a.artist_id JOIN track t ON t.album_id = a.album_id WHERE r.name = 'Led Zeppelin' GROUP BY a.album_id, a.title ORDER BY sum(t.milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: What is the total revenue from all invoices?
turns.sql: SELECT sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice

turns.question: Who is the top-spending customer from Canada? Give their first and last name.
turns.sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Canada' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY sum(i.total) DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: List all of their invoices with the invoice date and total.
turns.sql: SELECT invoice_date, total FROM invoice WHERE customer_id = 3

turns.question: Who is their support rep? Give the first and last name.
turns.sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id WHERE c.customer_id = 3

turns.question: How many albums does AC/DC have?
turns.sql: SELECT count(*) AS albums FROM album a JOIN artist r ON r.artist_id = a.artist_id WHERE r.name = 'AC/DC'

turns.question: How many customers are there in each country? Show the country and the count.
turns.sql: SELECT country, count(*) AS customers FROM customer GROUP BY country

turns.question: Only the countries with more than 3 customers.
turns.sql: SELECT country, count(*) AS customers FROM customer GROUP BY country HAVING count(*) > 3

turns.question: Which 3 artists have the most albums? Show the artist name and the number of albums, most first.
turns.sql: SELECT r.name, count(*) AS albums FROM album a JOIN artist r ON r.artist_id = a.artist_id GROUP BY r.artist_id, r.name ORDER BY albums DESC LIMIT 3

turns.question: What is the total revenue for each billing country? Show the country and the revenue.
turns.sql: SELECT billing_country, sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country

turns.question: Which employees report to Nancy Edwards? Give their first and last names.
turns.sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON m.employee_id = e.reports_to WHERE m.first_name = 'Nancy' AND m.last_name = 'Edwards'

turns.question: What is the average track length in minutes for each media type? Show the media type name and the average.
turns.sql: SELECT m.name, avg(t.milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS avg_minutes FROM track t JOIN media_type m ON m.media_type_id = t.media_type_id GROUP BY m.media_type_id, m.name

turns.question: Which genre has the most tracks?
turns.sql: SELECT g.name FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: How many invoices were issued in 2023?
turns.sql: SELECT count(*) AS invoices FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2024-01-01'

turns.question: Who are the top 3 customers by total spending? Show first name, last name and the total spent, highest first.
turns.sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, sum(i.total) AS spent FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 3

turns.question: List the names of the tracks on the album 'Let There Be Rock'.
turns.sql: SELECT t.name FROM track t JOIN album a ON a.album_id = t.album_id WHERE a.title = 'Let There Be Rock'

turns.question: Which 5 genres have the most tracks? Show the genre name and the number of tracks, most first.
turns.sql: SELECT g.name, count(*) AS tracks FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name ORDER BY tracks DESC LIMIT 5

turns.question: Show the same, but count the tracks sold instead.
turns.sql: SELECT g.name, sum(il.quantity) AS sold FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT 5

turns.question: How many customers does each sales support agent look after? Show the agent's first and last name and the number of customers.
turns.sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, count(*) AS customers FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name

turns.question: How many invoices were there in 2022?
turns.sql: SELECT count(*) AS invoices FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2022-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2023-01-01'

turns.question: How much revenue did they bring in?
turns.sql: SELECT sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2022-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2023-01-01'

turns.question: And in 2023?
turns.sql: SELECT sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2024-01-01'

turns.question: What was the total revenue in each year? Show the year and the revenue.
turns.sql: SELECT extract(year FROM invoice_date) AS year, sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice GROUP BY 1

turns.question: Which employees are sales support agents? Give their first and last names.
turns.sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employee WHERE title = 'Sales Support Agent'

turns.question: How much revenue did each of them bring in through their customers? Show the name and the revenue.
turns.sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, sum(i.total) AS revenue FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE e.title = 'Sales Support Agent' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name

turns.question: Which of them brought in the most?
turns.sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE e.title = 'Sales Support Agent' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY sum(i.total) DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
turns.sql: SELECT count(*) AS tracks FROM track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_line il WHERE il.track_id = t.track_id)

turns.question: Which billing country has the highest average invoice total?
turns.sql: SELECT billing_country FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY avg(total) DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: Which artist has sold the most tracks?
turns.sql: SELECT r.name FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN album a ON a.album_id = t.album_id JOIN artist r ON r.artist_id = a.artist_id GROUP BY r.artist_id, r.name ORDER BY sum(il.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: How many customers have no company listed?
turns.sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM customer WHERE company IS NULL

turns.question: What was the total revenue in March 2024?
turns.sql: SELECT sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2024-03-01' AND invoice_date < '2024-04-01'
